svg.title: shared resource defaults and mutable instance rows
svg.desc: The resource system loads an immutable blob once. Creating a game object copies its component row bytes into mutable instance tables. Numeric and math writes modify these rows in place. Reset copies defaults for the selected component or game object back from the resource. Strings and nested containers reference the resource until replaced with registration-owned payloads. Mutable instances are implemented in the data library; engine resource integration remains pending.
svg.text: Resource loading borrows file bytes; game-object creation copies mutable row bytes once.
Resource stays alive while instances use it
No override row or changed-property bitset
Reference shared resource bytes until replaced; replacement payloads belong to the registration.
Reset targets a component row or one game object’s registered rows.
